titulo: The genitive: posse, tempo e wegen, während, trotz: Genitive with adjectives, time and place

aula.titulo: The genitive: posse, tempo e wegen, während, trotz
aula.objetivo: Use the genitive for possession (das Auto meines Vaters), with proper names (Annas Auto), in expressions of time and place (Ende des Jahres) and after wegen, während and trotz.

blocos.titulo: Genitive with adjectives and in expressions of time and place
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: with an adjective, the ending is «-en» in all genders: «das Auto meines alten Vaters», «die Tasche der netten Frau». STEP 2: the genitive appears in many EXPRESSIONS of time and place: «am Anfang des Jahres» (at the beginning of the year), «am Ende des Monats» (at the end of the month), «in der Mitte der Stadt» (in the middle of the city), «am Rand der Straße» (at the edge of the road). STEP 3: with a place name: «die Hauptstadt des Landes» (the capital of the country), «die Größe des Zimmers». STEP 4: «Name» and the weak masculine nouns form the genitive in «-ns» and «-en»: «des Namens», «des Studenten».
